entries.text:
Learnt command in VS Code terminal:
? for shortcuts
! for bash
/ for commands
@ for referencing code file
& for background job

/terminal-setup - install shift + enter key binding
!npm run dev or run app to start the app
/tasks to see the background task
/init to initialize claude.md -> project notes and architecture
!git add . && git commit -m "..." or commit to commit the code
/context --> to review context usage and etc.
/compact --> clear conversation history to reduce context usage
/clear --> to clear further when switching between task
/usage --> to show claude usage
